blurb: Guests enjoy indoor and outdoor attractions including roller coasters, laser tag, go-karts, mini-golf, bumper boats, bowling, arcade games, and a sports bar. The park offers birthday parties, group events, corporate events, and social gatherings with catering and private spaces. Attractions have height and weight restrictions and require signed waivers for some activities.
extraNote: No outside food or drinks allowed except birthday cake or cupcakes for parties · In rain, some outdoor attractions close; indoor attractions remain open · Active military get 10% off regular price Play Passes with ID · Parking is free · Deposit required for school and youth events ($50 non-refundable) · Open year-round
